const { readFileSync } = await import('fs'); const targets = [
      $root + '/packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts',
      $root + '/packages/main/src/handlers/worktree.ts',
      $root + '/packages/main/src/handlers/fixture.ts',
      $root + '/packages/main/src/handlers/test-auto.ts',
